name: Question 7
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/d413052fc43e2f16ef7149b53288e42763f935e1331d08008540aacd1a9ec932.png)

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of a left-opening parabola is the right-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/33c202ff9507c4994e7737d311f83ee2807ef966bcb3cb089098d38f47863fe8.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(0,0).$

Question 7
?

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?

a
(0,0)
b
(6,6)
c
(0,−6)
d
(6,0)
e
(6,−6)
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The vertex of a left-opening parabola is the right-most point of the parabola.

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are (0,0).
